integrity.computational_checks: Standalone verifier exhaustively enumerates 46,230 permutations of orders 3 through 8 and evaluates 230 exact assertions.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact block contraction, Bonferroni rare-event control, and mixed factorial moments of directed adjacencies.
integrity.verification_not_independent: Same-model review only; no independent mathematical verification is asserted.

scientific_limitations: Uniform unsigned linear permutations only; fixed three-marker conditioning; n tends to infinity.
No explicit finite-sample total-variation error bound is established.
Asymptotic theorem proved analytically; finite enumeration is corroboration, not an infinite proof.
Historical priority for an equivalent rare-event conditional formulation is not established definitively.
title: Signed-Poisson adjacency clusters conditioned on a rare common triplet
